sections.title: Search for a top-philic heavy resonance in association with top quarks in pp collisions at 13 TeV and 13.6 TeV with the ATLAS detector
sections.abstract: ATLAS searches for a new top-philic vector boson produced with top quarks and finds no significant excess, excluding a benchmark Z' below 1150 GeV at 95% confidence.
sections.claimed_result: No significant excess; the benchmark model excludes masses below 1150 GeV at 95% confidence.
sections.caveat: The exclusion depends on the simplified model and benchmark parameters.

sections.title: Ruling out nucleonic direct Urca cooling in low-mass neutron stars using nuclear data
sections.abstract: A Bayesian combination of nuclear-structure, INDRA-FAZIA, chiral-EFT, and astrophysical information reduces the posterior probability of nucleonic direct-Urca cooling below 1% for neutron stars at or below 1.4 solar masses within the adopted metamodel.
sections.claimed_result: Laboratory nuclear data strongly disfavor electronic direct-Urca onset at or below 1.4 solar masses within the nucleonic metamodel.
sections.caveat: The conclusion is model-dependent and does not cover every fast-cooling mechanism.

sections.title: First Experimental Evaluation of Stray Light Noise Modeling of kilometers-long Beam Tube Arms of Gravitational Wave Detectors
sections.abstract: LIGO beam-tube-baffle tests and simulations provide the first experimental evaluation of stray-light noise models, agreeing with measured strain to within factors of 3–10.
sections.claimed_result: Backscatter and diffraction models agree with measured strain within a factor of 3–10 and identify relevant spectral features.
sections.caveat: The remaining factor-of-3–10 agreement range leaves substantial modeling uncertainty.

sections.title: Observation of Kondo Effect in Rhombohedral Graphene Superlattices
sections.abstract: Transport measurements in hexalayer rhombohedral graphene moire superlattices show signatures consistent with tunable Kondo interactions and heavy-fermion behavior.
sections.claimed_result: Field and temperature trends are interpreted as Kondo-singlet breakdown and suggest a tunable Kondo-insulating state.
sections.caveat: The interpretation and suggested insulating state require spectroscopy and independent confirmation.

sections.title: Quantum-interference-driven orbital density wave and high-temperature superconductivity in trilayer nickelates
sections.abstract: A vertex-corrected density-wave calculation links spin-fluctuation interference to orbital/bond order and cooperative s± superconductivity in trilayer La4Ni3O10.
sections.claimed_result: Quantum interference generates orbital/bond order and helps stabilize an s± state with a calculated transition scale on the 100-K scale.
sections.caveat: The mechanism and transition scale depend on model parameters and vertex approximations.

sections.title: A thermal microwave bus for neutral atom quantum computing
sections.abstract: The authors propose cavity-mediated long-range gates for neutral-atom arrays and report a simulated bichromatic Raman gate fidelity of F=0.997.
sections.claimed_result: A microwave-cavity bus is predicted to enable long-range gates and shorten representative error-correction rounds.
sections.caveat: The fidelity and code improvements are simulated predictions, not hardware demonstrations.

sections.title: Tangled tau: Planck CMB Constraints on Flash Reionization
sections.abstract: An MCMC fit of flash reionization to Planck data finds broad flash-redshift constraints and no significant shift in standard Lambda-CDM parameters.
sections.claimed_result: Planck PR4 permits benchmark flash ionization fractions while PR3 gives upper bounds; optical depth remains similar to the standard parametrization.
sections.caveat: The mild PR4 preference becomes an upper bound with PR3 and is not a detection.

sections.title: EPOCHS-DR2 I: Expanded data release and properties of 6.5<z<16.5 photometrically selected galaxies across NIRCam deep fields
sections.abstract: EPOCHS-DR2 provides a 2452-galaxy JWST/NIRCam sample at photometric redshifts 6.5–16.5, including 62 candidates above 10.5 and released catalogs and SED products.
sections.claimed_result: The release finds a flattening UV-slope–luminosity relation and identifies candidates, including 15 above photometric z=13.5.
sections.caveat: Most of the gold sample above z=10.5 lacks spectroscopic follow-up, leaving contamination and selection effects.
